leadText:
This is the third chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the April 2021 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on February 20, 2021. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on CoroCoro Online on November 18, 2021 and on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
